name: Docker Compose on Kiri
start: DOCKER_HOST=$(docker context inspect kiri --format '{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}') DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 docker compose up -d --build
stop: DOCKER_HOST=$(docker context inspect kiri --format '{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}') docker compose down --remove-orphans
purge: DOCKER_HOST=$(docker context inspect kiri --format '{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}') docker compose down -v --remove-orphans --rmi local
clean: DOCKER_HOST=$(docker context inspect kiri --format '{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}') docker compose down -v --remove-orphans
